name: snap2ui
description: Convert reference screenshots into pixel-faithful, componentized frontend pages.

interface.shortDescription: Rebuild screenshot UI as real frontend components.
interface.longDescription: Snap2UI guides Codex through reference-image decomposition, component architecture, exact visual reconstruction, interaction implementation, and screenshot-based validation. It treats the original image as a development oracle, not as the final visible UI.
defaultPrompt: $snap2ui Rebuild this screenshot as real frontend components.
$snap2ui Recreate this mobile UI using the current project stack.
$snap2ui Validate and fix visual differences from the reference.
